title: BillingIntentResult
description: billing.intent-result@1: answers of billing.intent.create on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/intents → { intent, checkout_url } (null when the provider has no hosted checkout); GET /api/v1/intents/:id → { intent }; POST /api/v1/intents/:id/capture → { result, intent } (the settlement the provider's capture produced).

result.description: Capture: what applying the provider's plan did.
